stage_a.name: One retained fictional canary; no deletion experiment
stage_a.purpose: Observe actual user-owned upload identity and bytes without making a deletion or absence claim.

payload.text: TransitionForward Storage Canary. Fictional text for a non-destructive staging observation. This file contains no student information.

stage_a.path: New fictional student UUID / new attempt UUID - privacy-safe-document.txt; exact canonical server-confirmed path only. No prefix listing, existing-file read, shared path or overwrite.
sequence: Verify exact staging source/backend/payment isolation before creating anything. Read no credentials into output.

Create at most one fictional owned student. Compute the existing documentUploadReviewHash over the fixed reviewed details; reserve the exact new attempt through reserve_document_upload. Require an exact matching receipt before storage.

Make at most one user-authenticated upload with upsert:false, fixed harmless bytes and a 30-second deadline. Timeout/lost response is uncertain, not permission to retry or infer absence. The request count is consumed when dispatched.

Call hold_document_upload_for_review at most once using the original actor and unchanged reviewed intent. If the response is uncertain or access changed, stop further observations and reconcile through separately authorized trusted access; do not repeat upload or hold.

Only after an exact hold receipt: observe read_document_upload_recovery once. Metadata not_observed never means physical absence. Observe Storage info once and compare the exact original path/owner/object/version before any download.

Only if identity is exact and current access is confirmed: download the single harmless file once, enforce 1024-byte maximum and compare the fixed SHA-256. Do not retain response bodies or generated signed URLs in logs.

At most one trusted exact metadata SELECT can independently compare the expected row tuple. Do not scan a bucket or read any existing user objects. This is a metadata cross-check, not physical deletion proof.

Stop. Preserve exact fixture/operation coordinates privately and report only stage, request counts, match booleans and constant result codes. No registration, scanning, extraction, job generation or deletion follows.
stage_a.timeouts: Each dispatched call has a 30-second deadline; the runner must have a five-minute overall deadline and count attempts before dispatch. Cancellation is not proof that a provider write stopped.
stage_a.uncertainty: Any missing/foreign receipt, changed identity/access, HTTP error, timeout or unexpected extra request stops. Keep the attempt reserved/held and counted; no blind retry, compensating write or deletion.
stage_a.retained_artifacts: Zero or one harmless object, one fictional student and one attempt remain intentionally retained for separate reconciliation. Do not delete the student or attempt to reset capacity. Even a failure may leave the upload present.
stage_a.cleanup: NONE in stage A. This deliberately replaces the earlier generic cleanup prerequisite only for a future specifically authorized retained canary; it does not waive cleanup requirements for other tests or grant terminal resolution.
stage_a.acceptance: Exact observed tuple and fixed byte hash can accept this one upload/read path only. It cannot accept all roles, concurrency, rollback/absence, deletion, production, scan accuracy, provider quiescence or reference completeness.
